item.name: Get and Filter Security Providers by Ids for an Organization.

request.name: Get and Filter Security Providers by Ids for an Organization.

description.content:
Lists the requested [security providers](https://docs.coveo.com/en/242/) by their respective ids. The unknown ids are ignored.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SECURITY_PROVIDER","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

query.description:
The text to filter security providers by (applied to the id, and displayName properties).
**Example:** `Email Security Provider`

response.name: OK

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2
